annotations.title: Launch kit: favicon.ico, PNG app icons, web manifest, OG image (hosted) from a name

description: Favicon and app icon generator plus share image in one call, for a new website, web app, docs site or API: give a name (and an optional tagline) and get favicon.ico (16/32/48), icon.svg, favicon-32x32.png, apple-touch-icon.png (180, opaque), PWA icons 192 and 512 plus a maskable 512, a site.webmanifest (name, theme and background colors, icons), a 1200x630 og-image.png with the name and tagline, and the logo mark and horizontal lockup as SVG, all from one generative logo (a small landscape: sky, sun or moon, hills / peaks / dunes / mesas / isles) in one palette. Every file is a hosted, permanent, public URL (signed; nothing to download or host), and head_html is the ready <link rel="icon">, apple-touch-icon, manifest, theme-color and og:image tags. Real PNG and ICO files drawn in the Worker, no headless browser. Same name, same kit. Free sample: /v1/launch-kit/sample. PAID: $0.05 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

name.description: Site, app, product or service name, exactly as it should be spelled (1-40 characters; Latin letters with common accents, digits, punctuation).

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

seed.description: Text that picks the logo scene and colors (default: the name), 1-256 characters. Try another seed for another look with the same name.

shape.description: Outline of the favicon and the 192/512 icons: rounded (default, app-icon square), circle or square. apple-touch and maskable icons are always full-bleed squares.

tagline.description: Optional tagline: the OG image subtitle and the manifest description (up to 80 characters).
